g.aria-label: Eliminating XLA Recompilation Storms in JAX Reinforcement Learning
RL loops query single NumPy states millions
of times while weights update every step
Reads live v.get_raw_value() leaves in O(1)!
Variable episode lengths n trigger XLA re-jits!
At most 5 compiled XLA kernels for any n!
All lengths n ∈ [1, 64] map to bucket size 64 → 1 single XLA compilation!
Multiplying per-sample losses by mask and dividing by mask.sum() keeps gradients exact.
